records.title: popsicle Fastboot DATA response can be fragmented across USB reads
records.summary: In one verified Xiaomi popsicle OS3 downgrade, the bootloader split the fixed 12-byte Fastboot DATA00052000 reply for a 335872-byte abl image into DATA000520 and 00. A one-read parser interpreted only six hex digits and stopped before transfer. The successful bounded parser reassembled all 12 bytes, parsed exactly eight hexadecimal digits, and required the accepted length to equal the verified image size.
symptoms: Fastboot download length appears much smaller than the selected image
A DATA response ends after six visible hexadecimal digits in one USB read
The host stops before sending image bytes even though the bootloader accepted download
error_codes: accepted length does not match verified image size
diagnostic_steps: Preserve the raw response read boundaries and verify whether the complete Fastboot DATA response totals exactly 12 bytes.
Compare the eight-digit hexadecimal length with the exact verified image byte count before sending any payload.
Confirm the failure occurred before image bytes and before flash:<partition>; do not infer a partition write from a download-request response.
fix_steps: Prefer a current standard Fastboot client when it behaves correctly for the exact target.

For the verified fallback only, accumulate the fixed 12-byte DATA%08x response across bounded USB reads, reject malformed or extra content, parse exactly eight hexadecimal digits, and require an exact byte-count match.
Keep protocol parsing separate from write authorization; successful response parsing grants no permission to transfer or flash an image.
prerequisites: Exact Xiaomi 17 Pro Max product/codename popsicle
Exact source and target build evidence
Standard Fastboot path attempted or independently shown unsuitable
expected_outcomes: The host reconstructs DATA00052000 as 335872 bytes and does not confuse one USB packet with one protocol message.
Malformed, incomplete, oversized, or mismatched DATA responses stop before image transfer.
compatibility: Verified once on Xiaomi 17 Pro Max popsicle during the OS3.0.319.0.WPBCNXM slot-A field installation
known_incompatibility: Not evidence that every popsicle, Fastboot implementation, host controller, cable, or firmware package needs a custom parser
Not an execution recipe or permission to bypass Guardian
recovery_routes: Stop before transfer when the accepted byte count cannot be proven
Return to current official Platform-Tools when the standard client works normally

scope.scope_note: One-device field evidence for the exact observed transition and active slot A. The transport lesson is reusable only after a new target reproduces the same bounded protocol evidence.

records.title: popsicle OS3 field case required a bounded staged Fastboot fallback
records.summary: For one exact Xiaomi popsicle downgrade, standard Fastboot produced unsupported-slot, zero-size, and invalid-argument behavior. A bounded helper succeeded with one exact in-memory serial binding, VID:PID 18d1:d00d, unsuffixed partitions after selecting and verifying slot A, 64 KiB transfers, 120-second completion timeouts, and explicit separation of download staging from flash dispatch and final result. The helper exposed only getvar, set-active a, and one-partition flash; it had no erase, format, slot-B, unlock, relock, script, or arbitrary-command path.
symptoms: The package's _ab partition target is rejected as not supporting slots
Fastboot reports a partition size of zero
Standard Fastboot fails or hangs on a slot or partition-size query
USB transport reports kernel error -71 or -110
diagnostic_steps: Verify one unambiguous exact popsicle target and retain its serial only in memory for transport binding.
Record the current slot, product, unlock state, exact tool version, host controller, cable, package digest, and the stage where failure occurred.
Distinguish download request, byte transfer, download-complete OKAY, flash command dispatch, and final flash result.
For USB -71 or -110, isolate the physical path with a known-good cable and a different direct motherboard port before attributing the fault to firmware.
fix_steps: Prefer current official or package-bundled Fastboot when it completes the exact operation reliably.

If the exact verified failure recurs, use only a reviewed bounded adapter that enforces the complete DATA response, 64 KiB chunks, 120-second bounded timeouts, exact target binding, and one operation per invocation.
After selecting slot A, re-read and require current-slot a before using the exact package-prescribed unsuffixed target order.

For USB -71 or -110, disconnect USB, hold Power for about 20 seconds, immediately enter FASTBOOT with Volume Down, and reconnect through a different direct port with a known-good cable; then reacquire all authority from fresh evidence.
prerequisites: Exact popsicle identity and active slot A
Exact package and per-image SHA-256 manifest
Reviewed package order and complete recovery material
Fresh Guardian decision and one-use consent for each consequential chain
No bootloader lock or relock action
expected_outcomes: Each invocation handles at most one exact read or write and reports its final stage without hiding partial progress.
A transport failure cannot advance to another partition, an erase, or reboot.
The raw serial is not persisted.
compatibility: Verified once for popsicle OS4.0.0.32.XPBCNXM to Xiaomi.eu OS3.0.319.0.WPBCNXM on slot A
known_incompatibility: Slot B was not refreshed or validated and must not be selected from this evidence
The package shell script was not safely runnable as one opaque action because it was not fail-fast
The fallback is not a universal replacement for standard Fastboot
recovery_routes: Stop and investigate the exact current stage without advancing
Recover the USB path physically, then reacquire exact-device evidence
Use separately validated stock recovery material; never relock

scope.scope_note: One-device, exact-transition, slot-A evidence. It supports diagnosis and adapter design only; every future target and package must be freshly revalidated.

records.title: popsicle OS3 clean-install cleanup followed a complete 63-write audit
records.summary: The verified slot-A clean installation completed 49 ordinary image writes and 14 numerically ordered sparse super writes. Only after every required write had an exact success result and product popsicle plus current slot a were revalidated did the user-authorized metadata erase, userdata erase, and reboot each return OKAY. The resulting full wipe means previous user data and app integrations cannot be presumed retained.
symptoms: A downgrade package requires destructive cleanup after a complete image set
A script could reach metadata or userdata erase after an earlier failed write
One partition write lacks a trustworthy final result
diagnostic_steps: Count one exact durable success for each of the 49 ordinary targets and 14 ordered super pieces; duplicates, omissions, reordering, failed results, or unknown results fail the gate.
Freshly re-read product and current slot after the complete write set and before any destructive cleanup.
Treat a missing trustworthy result after flash:<partition> dispatch as UNKNOWN, not success or failure.
fix_steps: Do not advance, erase, reboot, or automatically retry after FAILED or UNKNOWN; preserve the journal and investigate the exact physical state.
A later retry of an uncertain partition requires fresh exact-target observation, unchanged verified input, a recovery assessment, and a new governed decision for that exact step.
Perform metadata or userdata cleanup only when the exact installation contract requires it, the full write audit passes, the target remains exact, and the user has explicitly consented to the wipe.
prerequisites: Exactly 63 expected write intents and exact success results
49 unique ordinary targets in package-prescribed order
14 sparse super pieces in numeric order
Fresh product popsicle and current-slot a evidence
Independent recovery material and no relock action
expected_outcomes: metadata and userdata remain untouched until the complete verified write set is present.
Successful cleanup and reboot are recorded separately from later successful Android boot.
Previous user data, Android Auto setup, Gboard setup, and app state are classified as erased or unverified rather than retained.
compatibility: Observed for the exact Xiaomi.eu OS3.0.319.0.WPBCNXM clean-install package on popsicle slot A
known_incompatibility: Not evidence that a data-preserving update should erase metadata or userdata
Not evidence that slot B contains a bootable or matching installation
Not authority to retry an unknown write or to lock or relock the bootloader
recovery_routes: Preserve the durable intent/result journal and reassess the exact target
Use separately verified stock recovery material without relocking
Reacquire consent before any wipe or recovery write

scope.scope_note: One user-confirmed full-wipe slot-A field outcome. The gate is evidence for planning only and grants no wipe, flash, retry, reboot, slot, unlock, or relock authority.
